summary: CONFLICT: Ramp feasibility - Nature 2025 paper (EV-0004) argues ramp models have serious physics/logistics problems, while Brichieri-Colombi (EV-0006) argues ramps were feasible.
content: verifier-conflicts-1: EV-0004 (Nature, Landreau 2025) argues construction-ramp models face unfavorable physics, prohibitive ramp length (~1.5km), and spiral-ramp slowness, proposing a pulley/counterweight alternative. EV-0006 (Brichieri-Colombi 2015) argues a ramp/sled combination WAS feasible with the resources of the time. These two engineering analyses reach opposite conclusions about ramp feasibility. Medium severity - both are modeling exercises, neither is archaeological proof. Recommended: present both as competing engineering hypotheses; the archaeological record (no ramp remains) is the deciding gap.
